name: Warp-Raider Nesaad
shortDescription: Warp-Raider Nesaad, represented in the Consortium and Arcatraz research story.
body: Named Zaxxis warp-raider Khay’ji says survived his failed attack. This is original interpretive art, not canonical game art or proof of exact appearance, costume, formation, or simultaneous presence. Compare it with the original Burning Crusade client/model before human review. See docs/research/consortium-and-arcatraz-visual-assets.json.
